help-ad-campaigns.title: Ad Campaigns
help-ad-campaigns.body: Elect a Business account in My Profile to open Ad Campaigns. Choose Inline ($45 / 7 days — shows while using FloqR features) or Mingl Gist ($25 / 7 days — shows while scrolling Mingl stories). Upload a PNG/JPEG/GIF flyer or paste HTML. Target all patrons or match profile datapoints. Submit sends the campaign to Master Admin for approval and scheduling.

help-completed-shoutouts.title: Completed ShoutOuts
help-completed-shoutouts.body: Completed ShoutOuts are club-approved (and finished) ShoutOuts kept for your records. Archive moves a ShoutOut out of Completed into Archive with compressed text and media (when the original included media). Re-Use opens Search to throw the same wording again. Save as my template appears only when the template background is modifiable (IsModifiable). Paid receipts stay in FloqR Inbox.

help-archived-shoutouts.title: Archived ShoutOuts
help-archived-shoutouts.body: Archive stores a compressed copy of your completed ShoutOut text and media (when the original included media) in low-cost Firebase storage, and removes it from Completed. Open Archive anytime to review past ShoutOuts. Re-Use still works from Archive.

botdee-ask-floqr.title: Ask FloqR with BOT DEE
botdee-ask-floqr.body: Ask FloqR with BOT DEE — tap the animated mark or wait for the prompt, then type what you want in plain words. Products: Mingl, RydR, BartR, ShoutOut, floqCast (superstar), clubs. Goals: say “I want to be able to…” (e.g. become a Club Admin) or “make me a superstar” for steps and links.

help-soccer-jersey.title: Soccer jersey ShoutOut
help-soccer-jersey.body: Search Soccer, Jersey, or a country/club (Tanzania, Chelsea). Each photo kit card is the LED back you will see on ShoutOut — Soccer · Jersey · Country or Club. Sizes 96×48, 64×48, 64×32. Name and 2-character mark overlay the kit; numbers stay center-justified.

help-floqcast.title: Make me a floqCast / superstar
help-floqcast.body: Pick a venue → private camera preview → pay $20 (Stripe pop-out) → Club Admin approves in the floqCast Queue → Go live on the floqCast board. Like a ShoutOut, but live video. Preview links use secret tokens so they cannot be guessed from a club URL.

help-floqcast-choose-venue.title: Choose a floqCast venue
help-floqcast-choose-venue.body: Search or choose a venue. The first four clubs are the nearest floqCast venues (GPS / localization). Cards show screen size and whether sound is supported. Type a club or event name to find more. Only clubs with floqCast enabled appear here.

help-become-club-admin.title: Become a Club Admin
help-become-club-admin.body: Request Club Admin access, then get venue approval.

help-become-dj.title: Become a DJ
help-become-dj.body: Elect DJ as your service role and associate with clubs.

help-become-promoter.title: Become a Promoter
help-become-promoter.body: Request Promoter access for guest lists and campaigns.

help-role-profiles.title: Role profiles overview
help-role-profiles.body: See how Club Admin, DJ, Promoter, and hospitality roles work.

help-staff-scheduling.title: Calendar & Scheduler
help-staff-scheduling.body: Club Admin Calendar shows Draft (purple), Pending (amber), Confirmed (green), and Open/unfilled cards — each with a written status, not color alone. Scheduler is the people × days draft/publish grid. Website ingest / publicVenueCalendar returns Confirmed assignments only. A green Paid this month pill is shown to Club Admins when staffSchedulingPaid=1.

help-club-notification-subscriptions.title: Club SMS and WhatsApp notification subscriptions
help-club-notification-subscriptions.body: Club Admin → Notifications: Send test alert uses the boxes currently checked. In-app (and Push) writes a System Message in FloqR Inbox. Email uses club admin addresses. SMS and WhatsApp still need a paid subscription plus an E.164 alert phone. Green pill = Firebase subscription 1 (prepaid $10 pack); red = 0. If Send test alert returns Authentication Error - invalid username, Firebase secret TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID must be the Account SID starting with AC (34 characters) from console.twilio.com — not the Auth Token and not an API Key (SK).

help-club-sms-notification.title: SMS notification subscription
help-club-sms-notification.body: The SMS pill is green when Firebase smsSubscribed is 1 (prepaid $10 pack, 466 credits, not monthly or yearly). Red/flashing means 0 — open ? and tap Subscribe $10. Credits remaining and last paid date are in this help. Uncheck SMS and Save to pause alerts without losing the paid pack.

help-club-whatsapp-notification.title: WhatsApp notification subscription
help-club-whatsapp-notification.body: The WhatsApp pill is green when Firebase whatsappSubscribed is 1 (prepaid $10 pack, 233 credits, not monthly or yearly). Red/flashing means 0 — open ? and tap Subscribe $10. Credits remaining and last paid date are in this help. Uncheck WhatsApp and Save to pause alerts without losing the paid pack.

help-schedule-message-templates.title: Schedule message templates
help-schedule-message-templates.body: Club Admin → Notifications → Message templates. These are System Messages (Inbox / Email / SMS / WhatsApp), not ShoutOuts. Edit title and body for New shift needs confirmation, Schedule update, Shift confirmed, and Shift declined. Placeholders: {club} {role} {when} {link} {worker}. Worker inbox uses Review & confirm shift — never Open Related ShoutOut.

help-schedule-confirm.title: Confirm assigned shifts
help-schedule-confirm.body: Inbox / Email / SMS links open Work Calendar. Look at each pending assignment, tick it (or Select all), then Approve selected. Opening the link does not confirm. Only the assigned service member can approve — Club Admin cannot confirm on their behalf.

help-template-catalog-report.title: Template catalog report
help-template-catalog-report.body: Lists every ShoutOut template type and which LED sizes it supports (Is96x48, Is64x48, Is64x32). A venue only offers a template when at least one of those flags is 1 and the matching VenueSupports* flag is 1. Birthday / split-media templates are 1 on 96×48, 64×48, and 64×32. 96×48 is 3-line side-by-side; 64×48 and 64×32 loop the photo then the 3-line shoutout with a FLOQR + handle card.

help-club-display-screens.title: FLOQR display screens
help-club-display-screens.body: Firebase clubLocations stores VenueSupports96x48, VenueSupports64x48, and VenueSupports64x32 as 0 or 1. templates stores Is96x48, Is64x48, and Is64x32 the same way. A venue only lists a template when at least one pair is 1. Xibo URLs stay display.html?location=id and display2.html?location=id — screen size is not in the URL. Birthday is offered on all three sizes (3-line side-by-side on 96×48; photo/shoutout loop on 64×48 and 64×32). Primary is display.html. Secondary is display2.html.

help-donpapi-led-wall.title: DonPapi ShoutOut LED wall
help-donpapi-led-wall.body: VIP ShoutOuts are carried by busboys on the handheld DonPapi LED wall — held in the air in front of patrons with the shoutout message on the center screen (club name at the top, glowing white scalloped border). Table LEDs (64×32) and portrait walls (960×1900) remain for other formats.

help-staff-week-calendar.title: Scheduler
help-staff-week-calendar.body: Club Admin Scheduler is a people × days week grid. Save shift closes the editor with Schedule card successfully saved. Create drafts, Publish schedule so workers confirm pending until confirmed, Select shifts to multi-delete, and Website ingest to put published shifts on the club site. Default shift window = club open − 2 hours through close + 1 hour.

help-staff-schedule-user-guide.title: Staff Scheduling User Guide
help-staff-schedule-user-guide.body: Open the ? beside Scheduler on Club Admin Scheduling. Create draft shifts, Publish schedule so workers confirm pending→confirmed, then Select shifts to delete several at once. Example: all Wednesday drafts plus a Thursday confirmed chip.

help-create-publish-schedule.title: Create and publish a staff schedule
help-create-publish-schedule.body: Add draft shifts on the people × days grid, review chips, then Publish schedule. Workers must confirm before a shift becomes confirmed. BOT DEE: create a schedule, publish schedule, how to schedule staff.

help-multi-delete-shifts.title: Delete multiple scheduled or draft shifts
help-multi-delete-shifts.body: Select shifts, mix day headers and chips, then Delete selected. Example: all Wednesday drafts plus one Thursday confirmed shift.

help-staff-worksheet.title: Work Sheet - Weekly Staff Calendar
help-staff-worksheet.body: Elected service members open Work Calendar in Settings. Inbox / Email / SMS confirmation links land here. Review pending assignments, tick each shift (or Select all), then Approve selected — opening the message does not confirm. The week grid shows published colleague shifts. Drafts stay in Club Admin.

help-service-members.title: Services & Service Members
help-service-members.body:
Everyone starts as a FLOQR patron. On My Profile & Settings, tap Elect to become a service member to unlock this tab. Choose your service role (Waitress, DJ, Promoter, and more), search and select one or more clubs, then submit at the bottom of this page.

Profile template guide — patron social profiles stay on Public Media. Service roles use dedicated profile templates on My Profile:
• Patron — music, travel, hobbies, nightlife style, looking to meet; 8 photos and 2 short videos.
• Promoter — active cities, events, guest lists, VIP tables, venue relationships, promo media.
• DJ — genres, residencies, booking availability, mix links, crowd style, performance media.
• Waitress / Waitress / Bottle Girl — venue experience, service style, languages, nights, bottle service, professional media.
• Bus Boys or Security — floor support, door, security stations, venue experience, professional media.
• Venue Manager — venues managed, ops specialties, staff coordination, professional media.

Club Admin approval — each club's Club Admin approves your association after you submit. Club Admins: open Club Admin → Employee/Workers → Pending Worker Requests (Approve or Reject), or on this tab open Review & elect.

help-venue-website-ingest.title: Club website ingest (API, RSS, iframe)
help-venue-website-ingest.body: Club Admin → Scheduling → Website ingest. Generate a secret (shown once; only a hash is stored). Pull published staff shifts onto the official club website with JSON (?format=json&dataset=schedule|hours|profile|all), RSS, or an iframe snippet. Drafts, worker email, and phone are never included. Rotate the secret if it leaks.

help-venue-hours-calendar.title: Venue opening hours
help-venue-hours-calendar.body: On Club Public Profile, set the default weekly open/closed hours, then add period overrides for special weeks without losing the default. The public club page shows a Sun–Sat week grid with the date range (e.g. Sun 9 – Sat 15, Aug 2026) and calendar coloring. Upcoming public holidays list open/close hours and call out when they differ from the usual weekday. Staff Scheduling uses open − 2h through close + 1h. Guest List can suggest open nights.

help-club-admin-affiliation.title: Club Admin venue assignment
help-club-admin-affiliation.body: Club Admins only open the Venue Command Center for a club they are assigned to. Opening admin.html without a venue no longer defaults to Zebbies. Demo accounts temp_clubadmin_N@floqr-demo.com map to temp-democlub-N. Unassigned admins request assignment from Master Admin.

help-general-notifications.title: General Notifications
help-general-notifications.body: SOS2FA and other FloqR system messages follow these flags as set in a patrons your user record. Venues or specific independent service members need to subscribe to paid SMS/WhatsApp Twilio services

help-app-language.title: App language
help-app-language.body: On first use, FloqR reads the browser language (for example nl-NL → Dutch / Nederlands) and switches chrome and menus to that language when it is supported — Search categories, My Profile tabs, Club Admin tabs, and Master Admin tabs. Unsupported languages stay in English. After that, My Profile → App language and the saved profile language win. Saving App language re-translates every page that loads FLOQRI18n, not only this card.

help-my-profile.title: Profile & Settings
help-my-profile.body: Manage your profile, My Privacy, AI notifications, ShoutOut templates, public media, ShoutOuts, guest lists, FloqR Inbox, and Mingl. Open Profile & Settings for roles, seller tools, and account options.

help-profile-account-type.title: Account type
help-profile-account-type.body: Personal is the default FloqR patron account. Choose Business only if you need Ad Campaigns (Inline or Mingl Gist ads that Master Admin must approve). You stay a patron either way. Business shows a business-name field and the Ad Campaigns tab.

help-profile-height.title: Height
help-profile-height.body: Choose ft or m first, then type your height in that unit. Feet uses 6'0". Meters uses 1.78. Mixing them is blocked — 1.78 cannot be saved as ft, and 6'0" cannot be saved as m. United States defaults to ft. Every other country, and a non-U.S. internet location, defaults to m. You can still switch the unit.

help-floqr-handle.title: FloqR / Mingl handle
help-floqr-handle.body: FloqR / Mingl handle: letters, numbers, underscores (_), and dashes (-) only. No spaces, emoji, or other symbols. Shown as @your_handle on public profiles.

help-profile-country.title: Country
help-profile-country.body: Choose your country from the list. United States is first, then Canada, then featured nightlife markets, then every other country. The list is stored on this page so Profile loads quickly — it is not fetched from a database. Country sets your mobile calling code (+1 for the United States), the height unit default, and ZIP vs postal on taxi pickup.

help-profile-mobile.title: Mobile
help-profile-mobile.body: Mobile is required. FLOQR uses this number to recognize you — one mobile means one FLOQR account. Country fills the calling code, for example (+1) for the United States. Enter only the rest of your mobile number. We store it in international format (E.164) so SMS and WhatsApp can reach you. If this number is already on another FLOQR sign-in, you will be asked to use that account instead of creating a second one.

help-prior-travels.title: Prior Travels (City or Country)
help-prior-travels.body: List cities or countries you have already visited, comma-separated (Barcelona, Miami, Spain). Use real place names — FLOQR suggests spelling from a city/country catalog, then Google AI Studio (Gemini) when you are signed in. This is the public Mingl travel datapoint when you opt in under Privacy.

help-future-travel.title: Future Travel Destination (City or Country)
help-future-travel.body: List cities or countries you want to visit next, comma-separated (Lisbon, Japan). Enter a city or a country, not a venue or neighborhood. FLOQR suggests standard spelling. When you opt travel in under Privacy, BOT DEE can use these destinations the same way as prior travels.

help-taxi-pickup-address.title: Taxi pickup address
help-taxi-pickup-address.body: RydR pickup needs a street number, street name, city, state or province (for the listed countries), and ZIP or postal code. U.S. residents enter a ZIP (12345 or 12345-6789). Canada and other countries, or a non-U.S. internet location, use a postal code. FLOQR fills the label automatically from your profile country and IP. This address stays private on your account — it is not a public Mingl datapoint.

help-onboarding.title: Onboarding
help-onboarding.body: Patron / service-member onboarding — request Club Admin, DJ, Promoter, or hospitality access. Master Admins can also onboard venues.

help-mingl-search.title: About Mingl search
help-mingl-search.body: Search public profiles by shared interests, lifestyle, music, travel, food, events, cars, city, username, or who you want to meet.

help-default-template.title: Default Template
help-default-template.body: Free Traditional Black and White Classic. Templates made only for this venue, such as Football Intro or Tengo muchos dólares, are listed under Exclusive at the venue name. Use BOT DEE below for Sports, Jersey, VIP, Humor, Cars, Video, Pictures, and Ballers templates.

help-botdee-template-search.title: BOT DEE template search
help-botdee-template-search.body: Tap the moving BOT DEE mark (or wait for its speech bubbles), then ask for Sports, Jersey, NBA, NFL, Cars, Humor, VIP, Video, Pictures, or Ballers.

help-mingl-requests.title: About Mingl Requests
help-mingl-requests.body: Sent and received Friend or Mingl Requests appear here. Requests stay on the main Mingl page; accepted conversations open in Mingl Chat.

help-club-messaging-logs.title: SMS & WhatsApp delivery logs
help-club-messaging-logs.body: Club Admin → Marketing → SMS & WhatsApp Logs shows Twilio SMS and WhatsApp for this venue (marketing Send test, club alerts). The same rows appear under Master Admin → Twilio. Dry-run means secrets or From were missing — nothing was delivered and credits were not debited. Phones are masked.

help-club-messaging-credit.title: SMS & WhatsApp Credit
help-club-messaging-credit.body: Each $10 pack funds $7.00 of Twilio delivery capacity; FloqR keeps $3.00 as platform profit on the pack. SMS pack → 466 messages (≈ $0.015 all-in US SMS). WhatsApp pack → 233 messages (≈ $0.030 Twilio + Meta marketing). When balance reaches 0, buy another $10 messaging bundle before sending more campaign messages. Ops SMS unlock ($10) also grants one SMS pack. WhatsApp service ($10) grants one WhatsApp pack. Pack math: $10 → 466 SMS or 233 WhatsApp ($7.00 Twilio / $3.00 FloqR).

help-club-marketing-campaigns.title: Marketing campaigns
help-club-marketing-campaigns.body: Pick an industry template, load background and extra images, edit copy, then save or send. Sending debits SMS or WhatsApp credits from Messaging Credit.

help-club-in-app-marketing.title: In-app marketing
help-club-in-app-marketing.body: Publish an interstitial spot ad into the FLOQR advertisement pool (Mingl, RydR, clubs, shoutout slots). Use templates based on your venue's upcoming events. No SMS credits required.

help-public-media-sharing.title: Public Media and Data Sharing
help-public-media-sharing.body: Choose several images or short videos at once, then arrange their public-profile order. Profiles support up to 8 images and 2 short videos.

help-do-not-sell.title: Do Not Sell or Share
help-do-not-sell.body: Turn this on to opt out of sale/share-style personalization. FLOQR will not score ads with your profile tags. House and all-audience creatives may still show. If your browser sends Global Privacy Control (GPC), we set this automatically. Open the Privacy Policy for CCPA / CPRA details.

help-welcome.title: Welcome to FLOQR
help-welcome.body: Search and book entertainment and nightlife events worldwide, send a live ShoutOut to one of our ShoutOut displays, or Mingl with new people, friends, and family. Sign in with Google, Microsoft, Facebook, or a One Time Password (OTP). An OTP is a short code FLOQR sends to your email, by SMS (US and Canadian numbers only), or to WhatsApp (worldwide). Type the code within a few minutes to sign in — no password to remember. Each code works only once. Never share your code with anyone.

help-location-search.title: Location-aware search
help-location-search.body: FLOQR lists events and clubs closest to you first, then by name. When you allow it, FLOQR uses your phone or browser location (GPS); otherwise it estimates your city from your internet connection (IP). Type a place, like Clubs in Monaco, to search somewhere else — results there still start with the closest to you. You can turn location access off in your browser or phone settings.

help-beta-tester.title: Beta testing
help-beta-tester.body: FLOQR sometimes invites patrons to try new features early. The invitation arrives in your Inbox; open it while signed in to the same account and choose Accept. Only the features FLOQR chose for you then appear on Search with a Beta label. They may change or be switched off during testing. Invitations expire after 7 days and only work for the account they were sent to.

help-beta-booking-disclaimer.title: Booking Transaction Disclaimer
help-beta-booking-disclaimer.body: As a FloqR beta tester, you accept that reversing payments is difficult during beta. Ticket sales, table reservations, VIP entry, and other payments on beta features are final and non-refundable by FloqMedia. You participate at your own risk. Disputes about venue entry or payment must be resolved with the venue or the payment processor (e.g., Stripe, Papi, or Social OS).

help-football-intro.title: Football Intro
help-football-intro.body: A $30, 20-second stadium intro for four players, offered at Zebbies Garden DC, Heist Washington DC and Aurelia. Type “Football Intro” in Search, pick one of those venues, then upload four photos you have permission to use. Plays on 96×48 displays only.

help-tengo-muchos-dolares.title: Tengo muchos dólares
help-tengo-muchos-dolares.body: $30 Heist Washington DC exclusive. Your message plays in front of the vault for 5 seconds; then the vault door blows open and $100 bills splash behind your words for 10 seconds. The board closes with the HEIST logo over Washington DC, then loops. Type “Tengo muchos dólares” in Search, then enter only a name or pick an @Instagram / @Mingl handle (max 14). The board shows the name and types “Tengo muchos dólares... I just did a heist!” letter by letter. Plays on 96×48 displays only.

help-shiloh.title: Shiloh
help-shiloh.body: $30 Aurelia exclusive. Shiloh the cat sits on the left of the board and your ShoutOut glows in white on the dark side beside her. Emoji are welcome. Type “Shiloh” in Search, write up to three short lines, and add your @handle if you like. Plays on the board sizes Aurelia has.

help-classic-halloween.title: Classic Halloween
help-classic-halloween.body: $15 Classic Halloween, at every club. The classic three-line ShoutOut board on a moonlit graveyard with jack-o'-lanterns, and emoji are welcome. At the end of each cycle, white ghosts burst out of a grave and rush toward the crowd while the Reaper rises and bats swarm. Type “Halloween” in Search, write up to three short lines, and add your @handle if you like. Plays on 96×48, 64×48 and 64×32 boards.

help-display-idle-default.title: Idle board: Use ShoutOut @ venue
help-display-idle-default.body: When no ShoutOut is playing, Display 1 shows “Use ShoutOut @” followed by your venue name. Each approved ShoutOut plays for 10 minutes, then the board returns to that message on its own. Reset display to default in Club Admin does the same right away.

help-club-template-repository.title: Your club's templates
help-club-template-repository.body: Templates made only for your club are listed first and marked Exclusive at your venue name. Assigned templates are the ones patrons can pick at your club; use Assign template or Remove template to change that. Search finds a template even with a missing accent or a small typo.

help-employee-network.title: Employee / Worker Network
help-employee-network.body: Only people linked to this club are listed: staff elected or approved here, club admins, and staff affiliated with this club. To give someone a role, type their name, username, or email under Elect Patron for Role, tap Select next to the right person, choose the role, then tap Elect Selected Patron Role and confirm. The person needs a FLOQR patron account first. Waiters, waitresses, and bottle girls on the list can be made customer service representatives (CSR).

help-template-tags.title: Template tags
help-template-tags.body: Add words patrons might type when they look for a template at your venue, such as game night or birthday. Template Managers can add tags. Template Administrators and Club Admins can also remove tags. Club Admin assigns these roles under Role Activity & Permission.

help-template-preview.title: Preview a template
help-template-preview.body: Tap Preview on any template card to watch it play on a sample board with made-up text and pictures. Switch between the display sizes this venue has. Your own ShoutOut shows your words and photos.

help-shoutout-recommendations.title: ShoutOut Recommendations
help-shoutout-recommendations.body: Pick a style and an event type, then tap Improve My ShoutOut for ideas that fit your template and display size. Tap any idea to put it in your message, then edit it if you like. Use Past ShoutOut brings back one of your earlier messages.

help-ai-recommendations.title: AI Recommendations
help-ai-recommendations.body: Ideas written for you from the venue, the event type, your draft and your profile. Every idea already fits the lines and characters your chosen display allows. Tap one to use it.

help-trending-shoutouts.title: Trending ShoutOuts
help-trending-shoutouts.body: Popular ShoutOuts approved by FLOQR, with picks that suit this venue's music first. Tap one to use it.

help-generic-shoutouts.title: Generic ShoutOuts
help-generic-shoutouts.body: Ready-made ideas for common moments such as birthdays and celebrations. Tap one to use it, then make it your own.

help-staff-marketing-consent.title: Staff marketing consent
help-staff-marketing-consent.body: When you join a venue or event team, you must tick the marketing consent box. It lets that venue or event organizer, and its admins and managers, use your FLOQR name, role, and published photos and videos on their websites, flyers, and social media (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and similar) without asking you again for each use. They may not publish your phone number or email. You can withdraw at any time in My Profile on the Services & Service Members tab. This stops new marketing; materials already printed or posted do not have to be recalled. Club Admins see each staff member's consent status in Employee / Worker Network and Featured service staff.

help-featured-staff.title: Featured service staff
help-featured-staff.body: Tick the staff you want on your public club page. For each person, tap one of their FLOQR photos or choose Upload from computer. You can change the role shown under their name. Press Save Public Profile to publish your changes. Before publishing photos, get each person's agreement and tick the photo consent box.

help-club-website-feed.title: Club website feed
help-club-website-feed.body: Show your published FLOQR club page on your own website. Press Generate feed key and links, then paste the iframe code into your website, or give your web admin the JSON or RSS link. The feed shows upcoming events, featured DJs, featured staff, gallery, and contact details, following your Public page controls. Staff photos appear only when photo consent is confirmed. Generating a new key turns off the old links, including the staff schedule links.

help-botdee-place-search.title: Ask BOT DEE for FLOQR venues
help-botdee-place-search.body: Ask in plain words — sushi restaurants in Washington DC, clubs in DC, or a named club. BOT DEE searches onboarded FLOQR venues only, not Google or Yelp. Matching clubs open their FLOQR public page. Patron photos and ShoutOut / VIP pitches stay off unless you asked for those. If nothing is onboarded yet, BOT DEE says so.

help-botdee-page.title: BOT DEE
help-botdee-page.body: Chat with BOT DEE on the BOT DEE page in plain words: events and clubs, ShoutOut, Mingl, RydR, BartR, FloqCAST, your profile, staff schedules, or Club Admin tools. Press Enter to send a message; Shift+Enter starts a new line. Type help (like version) and BOT DEE explains itself and asks what you want help with. BOT DEE chats like a person (try How are you?) and only looks things up when you ask how to do something in FLOQR. If you are signed in, BOT DEE keeps this chat when you refresh or open another phone. After the pause timer, BOT DEE can recap where you left off — pause does not delete the chat, memories, or workflows. BOT DEE asks how it can help at the start of a conversation (and again if you come back after a pause). Mid-chat replies stay short. Answers use classification for your account. Signed-in BOT DEE uses the same public volunteered profile datapoints you can see (music, food, travel, hobbies, and the rest of Privacy datapoint sharing) — never email, phone, card numbers, or GPS. The + at the top right opens saved chats. Collapse and New chat only hide the canvas — BOT DEE still keeps that history and uses it on Send. Export or delete stays in My BOT DEE. Saved chats, memories, and approved facts live in My Profile → Feature & Orders → My BOT DEE. Tap a photo in the chat to pop it out into a separate window. Close with X or Close to see the chat again.

help-botdee-privacy-session.title: BOT DEE privacy and session
help-botdee-privacy-session.body: The five-minute pause ends this live BOT DEE session. It does not delete this signed-in chat, memories, or workflows. Opt-in copies in My Profile → Feature & Orders → My BOT DEE stay too. Guests stay ephemeral. Mingl chats are never copied here. Press Enter to send a message; Shift+Enter starts a new line. Type help or privacy on the BOT DEE page. The + control lists saved chats without deleting them. Collapse is visual only — Send still uses stored history. Name, tone, and recap live in My Profile → Feature & Orders → My BOT DEE — not as a button on the chat.

help-scheduling-schedule-for.title: Staff Scheduling
help-scheduling-schedule-for.body: Plan shifts and bookings, then notify each person by Inbox, Email, SMS or WhatsApp. Under Schedule for, choose whose calendar you are working on: My DJ schedule is your own calendar, Club lists the clubs you manage, and Promoting company lists the companies you promote for. Each calendar has its own $20/month subscription. Shifts sent to you appear under My assignments, where you confirm or decline them.

help-vip-book-table.title: Book a VIP table (VIP reserV)
help-vip-book-table.body: VIP reserV lets you explore a club floor map and reserve a table. Open VIP reserV from Search (when granted), pick Decades or Lima Twist Club and a night, tap a green table, hold it for 30 minutes, accept Terms, and pay the deposit with FloqR Stripe. Bars and the DJ booth are never bookable. Brand name VIP reserV is never translated.

help-vip-floor-map.title: VIP reserV floor map
help-vip-floor-map.body: Green = available, amber = held, red = booked, grey = not bookable, blue = DJ booth. On phones the map opens on one area with chips to jump; pinch and pan; targets are at least 44px. Area names are club-editable; printed table labels stay as drawn.

help-vip-terms-consent.title: VIP reserV Terms & consent
help-vip-terms-consent.body: Before deposit checkout you must accept the venue Terms, refund/cancellation, no-show/forfeit, age 21+ with ID, and minimum-spend disclosure. Consent is recorded server-side with the Terms version hash. Marketing opt-in is optional.

help-vip-door-pass.title: VIP reserV door pass
help-vip-door-pass.body: After your deposit confirms, open My Profile → Reservations and tap Show pass for a one-time QR token. Bring ID 21+. Late arrivals follow the venue cutoff. Door staff use VIP reserV Door to check you in.

help-vip-door-ops.title: VIP reserV door check-in
help-vip-door-ops.body: VIP Managers open VIP reserV Door for tonight’s list. Scan or paste a pass token, confirm ID 21+, then check in. Mark no-show only after grace. Opening a notify link never changes reservation status.

help-vip-receipt-sms-redaction-fixes.title: VIP receipt SMS & invoice redaction
help-vip-receipt-sms-redaction-fixes.body: Paid receipts send SMS only through the logged Twilio Messages API path. FLOQR-YYYYMMDD-… and VR-… invoice numbers stay readable in mail/SMS logs (they are not treated as OTP codes).

help-floqr-inbox-rules.title: FloqR Inbox
help-floqr-inbox-rules.body: FloqR Inbox holds System Messages and internal support messages. The list loads first so your messages appear quickly. Tap the floating New Message button to compose — type a name or @username to find an allowed recipient (Club Admin, CSR, or approved staff). Patron-to-patron chat stays in Mingl after both patrons Mingl back. Opening a schedule invite does not confirm a shift — review and Approve selected on Work Calendar.

help-vip-choose-venue.title: Choose a VIP reserV venue
help-vip-choose-venue.body: Only clubs subscribed to VIP reserV appear here. The first four are nearest (GPS). Cards show open days, minimum deposit, dress code, and age. Search by name, city, or genre, then Select venue to open that club’s floor map and night picker.

help-vip-floqr-stripe-aurelia.title: Set FloqMedia Stripe for Aurelia (Demo Club)
help-vip-floqr-stripe-aurelia.body:
Aurelia (temp-democlub-1) uses FloqMedia Stripe (FloqR Checkout) as the default VIP deposit collector — patrons pay on FloqR’s platform Stripe, then the table marks booked.

Master Admin steps:
1) Open Master Admin → Features Mgmt → VIP reserV Payments.
2) Confirm VIP Reservations is enabled for the network (Features & Services / Release Control if needed).
3) Seed / refresh POS providers only if you also enable Club POS later — not required for FloqMedia Stripe.
4) Leave Aurelia on FloqMedia Stripe unless a live club needs Club POS or Club Stripe.
5) After deposits, open VIP reserV Payments → Network VIP billing to review FloqR settlements / invoices.

Club Admin steps (Aurelia):
1) Sign in as temp_clubadmin_1@floqr-demo.com (Email OTP on home) or your Club Admin account assigned to Aurelia.
2) Open Club Admin → VIP reserV (location=temp-democlub-1).
3) Under Payment collector, choose FloqMedia Stripe (FloqR).
4) Keep Require deposit before table is marked booked checked for demos.
5) Tap Save payment collector — status should confirm FloqMedia Stripe.
6) Smoke test: vip.html?location=temp-democlub-1 → hold a table → Terms → Pay deposit (Stripe test card 4242…).
7) Door / billing: Open Door for check-in; Refresh billing for statements.

Do not choose Club POS for Aurelia demos unless you intentionally connect Toast/SpotOn sandbox. FloqMedia, Stripe, ShoutOut, and VIP reserV stay untranslated brand names.

help-vip-payment-collector.title: VIP reserV payment collector & Club POS
help-vip-payment-collector.body: Preferred for live clubs with Toast/SpotOn: Club POS — FLOQR books, holds, and maps the table; the POS owns deposit, open tab, and spend. Alternatives: Club Stripe (venue Connect), FloqMedia Stripe (FloqR platform), or VIP reserV engine + CSV. Aurelia (Demo Club) defaults to FloqMedia Stripe — ask BOT DEE how to set FloqMedia Stripe for Aurelia for the Master Admin and Club Admin steps.

help-vip-table-isbooked.title: VIP table isBooked status in Firestore
help-vip-table-isbooked.body: Every VIP-onboarded club keeps one Firestore doc per table number for each night: clubLocations/{locationId}/vipNights/{YYYY-MM-DD}/tables/{tableNumber}. Doc id is the printed table number (e.g. T1, B3). After the booking flow completes (deposit paid on FloqMedia Stripe / Club Stripe, Club POS confirm, or admin recorded payment), isBooked is set to "1" and isBookedYes to "yes". Free tables stay "0" / "no". Holds do not set isBooked. Cancel sets isBooked back to "0". Club Admin can call ensureVipTables to seed upcoming nights; getVipAvailability also ensures docs.

help-chrome-scheme.title: Site chrome
help-chrome-scheme.body: Beta: switch the whole FLOQR site between Nightlife (neon cyan–magenta) and Traditional (charcoal / white). Colors, cards, and chrome update together. Your choice is stored as isSiteChrome on your profile (0 = Nightlife, 1 = Traditional; 2 and 4 are reserved). Available when FLOQR enables Site chrome and invites or assigns you. Find the switch in My Profile → Language Settings (not on public Search).

help-chrome-audit.title: Site chrome audit
help-chrome-audit.body: Master Admin only. After you switch Site chrome under My Profile → Appearance, FLOQR records each page you open and checks whether html[data-floqr-chrome] matches your choice (pass/fail). Open Master Admin → Diagnostics → Manual Feature Tests → Site chrome audit → Read Site chrome audit. If receipts stay on Nightlife, Copy chrome fix prompt and give it to Codex.

help-shoutout-choose-venue.title: Choose a ShoutOut venue
help-shoutout-choose-venue.body: Search or choose a FLOQR club for your ShoutOut. The first four are nearest (GPS). Cards show LED display sizes supported and whether patrons can create custom ShoutOuts. Select a venue to continue to templates.

help-search-settings-appearance.title: Settings on Search
help-search-settings-appearance.body: On the Home Search screen, tap Settings to open Profile & Settings on the Appearance tab — Site chrome (Nightlife, Traditional, Black Tiffany, White/Black, Purple & White, Black & Dark Green) lives there. The Settings tile uses the same chrome icon pack as the other Search marks.

help-black-card.title: Black Card (retired)
help-black-card.body: Black Card was removed from the ShoutOut catalog. Use Baller's Alert instead — $100 with your face under the warrior helmet, optional company (max 18, UPPERCASE).

help-ballers-alert.title: Baller's Alert
help-ballers-alert.body: $100 Baller's Alert — the Baller's Express BUSINESS metal card with your face under the warrior helmet. Use Upload photo → Photo library / files or Camera with face guide (one Upload control — no duplicate Take photo button). Gemini isolates you from the background (coarse edges — not salon hair matting); then zoom and position so only the face sits in the medallion. Helmet, rim, and chip stay. If background removal fails, retry or keep the original. Company is optional (max 18 characters, always UPPERCASE on the card; preset WE'RE OUTSIDE LLC). Valid Thru 12/50.

help-botdee-memory.title: BOT DEE saved chats
help-botdee-memory.body: Open Feature & Orders → My BOT DEE to save chats after the pause, export, or delete history. The five-minute pause ends the live BOT DEE session. If you opt in, BOT DEE keeps that chat so you can come back later. Guests are not saved. Mingl conversations stay in Mingl.

help-botdee-smartview.title: View my SMARTview
help-botdee-smartview.body: View my SMARTview shows your People card from public-within-FLOQR fields, using the same Profile Media as your FLOQR public page — not venue or restaurant mocks. Edit my SMARTsummary changes the text in your default profile language. Save translates it to every other FLOQR language, including English. Master Admin → Features → BOT DEE → SMARTviews is where labeled mock venue and restaurant cards live. There is no live Places or Yelp.

help-botdee-research-library.title: BOT DEE Research Library
help-botdee-research-library.body: Save places and cards you asked BOT DEE about. A Google Place ID is not a copy of Google’s photos or reviews. You can refresh or delete a saved item. Licensed caches stay off until the provider is approved.

help-botdee-explain.title: Explain My Recommendation
help-botdee-explain.body: Each recommendation can show evidence, the date it was checked, whether personalization was on, and if a placement is sponsored. You can ask BOT DEE not to personalize this search.

help-botdee-privacy-assistant.title: BOT DEE Privacy Assistant
help-botdee-privacy-assistant.body: Change what other FLOQR users see in My Profile visibility — BOT DEE does not add a second public switch. If web research attached the wrong person, you can dispute it here without changing your profile. BOT DEE cannot promise that a third-party site will delete the original page.

help-sinema-virtual-set.title: Si-nema virtual set
help-sinema-virtual-set.body: Si-nema loads a granted FloqMedia Spatial Studio project as a virtual set. FloqR stores the project id and the pinned revision only — photos, poses, meshes, and semantic geometry stay on FloqMedia. The first FloqR scene save starts a 48-hour edit window from that original server timestamp; later saves do not reset it. After 48 hours, edits need a separate authorization. A video model cannot preserve this geometry exactly.

help-floqr-oidc-floqmedia.title: FloqR account for Spatial Studio
help-floqr-oidc-floqmedia.body: Spatial Studio on FloqMedia uses your existing FloqR account. There is no FloqMedia signup. Guest drafts stay in the FloqMedia browser until you confirm attaching them to this FloqR account. FloqR issues a one-time authorization code (PKCE). Access tokens are not stored in the spatial project file.

help-botdee-knows-of-me.title: What BOT DEE knows of me
help-botdee-knows-of-me.body: Facts BOT DEE stored with your approval live in Feature & Orders → My BOT DEE. The list is empty if memory is off or nothing is stored. Export or delete facts here. BOT DEE never stores your IP address. Mingl chats are not copied.

help-botdee-smartview-edit.title: Edit your SMARTsummary
help-botdee-smartview-edit.body: Only you can edit your SMARTsummary, in your default profile language. That language is the source — English is the source only when your default is English. Save is immediate. FLOQR then translates SMARTsummary into every other supported language, including English. Gemini will not overwrite text you edited unless you ask it to regenerate. If your public profile changes, FLOQR asks you to review the summary instead of replacing it.

help-botdee-smartview-translation.title: How SMARTview translation works
help-botdee-smartview-translation.body: Your SMARTsummary is stored in your default profile language — that language is the source, even when it is not English. After you save, FLOQR queues a translation to every other supported language, including English. An English viewer sees the English SMARTsummary once that job finishes. While a translation is pending or failed, viewers see the source language with a clear label — never a stale translation presented as current.

help-botdee-smartview-privacy.title: SMARTview privacy and visibility
help-botdee-smartview-privacy.body: SMARTview shows only fields you already made public within FLOQR. It is not open-web search. Dating appears only with explicit opt-in. Hide a field in My Profile and it leaves SMARTview. Blocked people cannot see your card. Report an incorrect summary from the summary overlay.

help-botdee-smartview-media.title: SMARTview photos and videos
help-botdee-smartview-media.body: The compact card uses the same hero as your FLOQR public profile — the first Profile Media item (8 photos + 2 videos). Tap it for Photos and Videos from those public slots. Swipe or use arrows, then X (or Escape) to return to the same chat scroll and unsent draft.

help-botdee-smartview-categories.title: SMARTview categories
help-botdee-smartview-categories.body: Four tabs: Social, Dating, Dining, and Future Travels. Social opens on Music, then Nightlife, Sports, and Events. Tags are only what you shared — no duplicate headings and no invented trips, ratings, or relationships. Future travel shows only destinations you marked public.

help-botdee-smartview-chrome.title: SMARTview and Site Chrome
help-botdee-smartview-chrome.body: People SMARTview uses the viewing patron’s existing FLOQR Site Chrome (Nightlife, Traditional, Black Tiffany, White/Black, Purple & White, Black & Dark Green). There is no second theme setting. Changing chrome updates the card in place without losing your chat draft.

help-botdee-smartview-review.title: Review and correct a SMARTsummary
help-botdee-smartview-review.body: Gemini drafts the SMARTsummary in your default profile language from public-within-FLOQR fields only — never on each view. If a fact is wrong, hide the source field in Profile visibility or edit the SMARTsummary yourself. Owner-authored text is not overwritten. Profile changes that conflict with your summary ask for a review. Report an incorrect card from the summary overlay.

help-botdee-smartview-troubleshoot.title: SMARTview troubleshooting
help-botdee-smartview-troubleshoot.body: Empty card: the patron hid those fields or you are blocked. Save failed: sign in and retry — translations queue on the server, not this browser. Pending or failed translation shows the source language with a label. Edit is owner-only. Master Admin SMARTviews is still the mock catalog; live Places and Yelp stay off until counsel. Theme follows Site Chrome — there is no second SMARTview theme.

help-botdee-smartcard.title: People SMARTcards
help-botdee-smartcard.body: When more than one public FLOQR profile matches, BOT DEE shows compact People SMARTcards in the chat: square photo on the left, name, public handles, city, and a 4-line SMARTsummary on the right. Tap a card to open that person’s full SMARTview. Cards use the same public profile and SMARTsummary as SMARTview — not a second stored summary. Opening a card does not call Gemini.

help-botdee-smartcard-search.title: Ask BOT DEE who someone is
help-botdee-smartcard-search.body: Ask “Who am I?” to open your own SMARTview. Ask “Who is …” plus a name or @handle to look up public FLOQR profiles. One match opens SMARTview. Several matches show SMARTcards to pick from. Private, blocked, or unpublished profiles are not listed — BOT DEE will not confirm whether that account exists.

help-botdee-smartcard-sync.title: SMARTsummary stays in sync
help-botdee-smartcard-sync.body: Edit your SMARTsummary in your default profile language. Save is immediate. Cards and SMARTview already showing you update from the same record. Translations to other FLOQR languages run in the background and never overwrite a newer edit. If you hide your public profile, block someone, or delete the account, those cards disappear. Gemini does not overwrite text you wrote.

help-botdee-version-smartview.title: Version SMARTview
help-botdee-version-smartview.body: In BOT DEE chat, type Ver, Vers, or Version (any capitalization, optional ?). The Version SMARTview card is the only answer — BOT DEE does not dump package, model, six-phase, or mock-integration text in the chat bubble. It shows the real FLOQR package stamp, the Gemini model id this deployment uses (the same model executeBotSession would call, even when this turn skipped generation), and a live service status from a probe of this request. Numbers in design pictures are examples — live values come from the app. Site Chrome follows your Appearance theme.

help-botdee-version-smartview-status.title: Version SMARTview status is a live probe
help-botdee-version-smartview-status.body: Service status is probed on this Version request: Functions and package reachable with Gemini configured → Operational; Functions and package up but Gemini not configured → Degraded; Functions not in this request → Unavailable. It is never a static Not checked label. AI model shows the configured Gemini model id for this deployment even when this turn did not generate. Frontend and backend package stamps can differ; both are labeled. Master Admin may see extra diagnostics after Technical Details — patrons do not.

help-botdee-version-smartview-tabs.title: Version SMARTview tabs
help-botdee-version-smartview-tabs.body: Overview describes BOT DEE and opens Technical Details without leaving chat. What's New lists verified BOT DEE and Gemini changes only — not Master Admin, beta tester tools, or other FLOQR product notes. Help repeats the Ver / Vers / Version command. Switching tabs or expanding details keeps your unsent draft and scroll. The card uses your Site Chrome — there is no second theme.

help-botdee-room-smartview.title: Room SMARTview
help-botdee-room-smartview.body: In BOT DEE chat, say Open Room SMARTview, Start a group chat, or plan a Cancun trip in plain words. Confirm shows Join Now or Set a schedule. Join Now opens a Mingl-friends session now and does not paint Search. Set a schedule is when the BOT DEE room starts — not Shared Itinerary — and turns on Search SMARTnotification for you and invited Mingl friends. Invite Mingl friends only — host plus 7 guests. Guests can invite too. Joining is not a payment and does not open a shared tab. BOT DEE never takes card numbers. Private BOT DEE messages stay private. Site Chrome follows your Appearance theme. A live room stays open until the host taps End Room, about four hours after it opens, or everyone has been gone about 15 minutes. Pausing private BOT DEE chat is separate.

help-botdee-room-smartview-invite.title: Room SMARTview invite
help-botdee-room-smartview-invite.body: After you confirm Room SMARTview, share the join link. Named people are not looked up just because you typed a name — FLOQR will not say whether an account exists. Joining is not a payment and does not open a shared tab.

help-botdee-room-smartview-join.title: Join a Room SMARTview
help-botdee-room-smartview-join.body: Open a Room SMARTview join link while signed in, or paste it in BOT DEE. Joining the room is not joining a shared tab and does not approve a payment. BOT DEE never takes card numbers.

help-botdee-room-smartview-end.title: End Room SMARTview
help-botdee-room-smartview-end.body: Only the host can end a room. Ending does not charge anyone or erase other people’s private chats. An unpaid shared tab must be paid or voided first. A live room stays open until End Room, about four hours after it opens, or everyone has been gone about 15 minutes. Pausing private BOT DEE chat is not room logout. A guest leaving does not end the room while the host is still present.

help-botdee-room-smartview-tab.title: Room SMARTview shared tab
help-botdee-room-smartview-tab.body: A shared tab is a later opt-in. Joining the room does not join a tab. Joining a tab does not approve a payment. BOT DEE never takes card numbers. Split-the-bill talk is not a charge.

help-botdee-room-smartview-who-pays.title: Who is paying
help-botdee-room-smartview-who-pays.body: Ask Who’s paying in a Room SMARTview to see privacy-filtered opt-in status when tabs ship. Nobody is charged because someone said buy. Card last four stay on the payer’s own receipt.

help-botdee-room-smartview-kick.title: Remove someone from Room SMARTview
help-botdee-room-smartview-kick.body: Only a verified host can remove a member, and only after confirm. A model reply cannot kick anyone. There is no live room to change yet.

help-botdee-room-smartview-share.title: Share into Room SMARTview
help-botdee-room-smartview-share.body: Share this conversation never copies your private BOT DEE thread. BOT DEE shows a preview of selected shareable facts from this message, marked tentative. You can edit or drop facts. Nothing is published until rooms are live and you approve.

help-smartvisuals-notification.title: Mingl Room SMARTnotification
help-smartvisuals-notification.body: A compact Mingl Room Invitation can appear on Search when a Mingl friend scheduled a BOT DEE room you were invited to. View Invitation opens Room SMARTview. Join Now goes to BOT DEE, not Mingl chat. Not Now hides the card this tab; Inbox still has Review BOT DEE invite. The Cancun demo query is Studio-only. Art is illustration, not a photo. Join Now rooms without a schedule do not paint Search.

help-smartvisuals-room.title: Room SMARTview with SMARTvisuals
help-smartvisuals-room.body: Room SMARTview shows the Mingl invitation: schedule, RSVP or live status, and Join Now. Join Now on Search opens BOT DEE (not Mingl chat) with room= and t=. SMARTstencils and SMARTbackgrounds follow the authorized room title — Cancun Trip uses travel art, not a real Cancun photo. Private BOT DEE chat is never used to pick art. A labeled Ad below is a sample from those tags. It stays empty for private chat or injection and is not a live advertiser.

help-shoutout-headless-smartview.title: ShoutOut SMARTpreview
help-shoutout-headless-smartview.body: When you throw a ShoutOut in BOT DEE chat, BOT DEE uses that template's patron input list. Context already in the chat fills venue, shoutout text, names, and numbers. BOT DEE asks only for missing required fields, one at a time — there is no canned phrase you must say. Traditional needs a venue and shoutout text. When the list is complete, ShoutOut SMARTpreview is ready; reply throw it (or skip extras) to send. @handle is optional on Traditional. Photo, jersey, Football Intro, Heist name-only, and Baller's Alert use their own required fields; photo boards still open compose. A FloqR or third-party one-shot still sends venue, sign verbiage, and optional extras in one request.

help-botdee-headless-vip.title: VIP reserV from BOT DEE chat
help-botdee-headless-vip.body: Say VIP reserV or hold a VIP table at Aurelia in BOT DEE. Name the club, night, and table or area. Mezzanine is an area — BOT DEE lists V1–V4 and AURELIA SUITE so you can pick a table, then hold it, reply I agree to Terms, and pay if a deposit is required. BOT DEE never takes card numbers. Joining a Room SMARTview is not a payment.

help-features-smartview.title: Features SMARTview
help-features-smartview.body: Features SMARTview is the product catalog for BOT-DEE, Mingl, ShoutOut, RydR, floqCast, VIP reserV, Si-nema, and Si-tube. Open Overview, What's New, Feature Journey, All Features, Coming Soon, or Past/Retired. The catalog page opens without Search sign-in. Close dismisses the product detail sheet. Status is Production when Enable Feature is on and Enable Beta Feature is off, Testing when both are on, Beta when only Enable Beta Feature is on, and In development when Enable Feature is off. Dates stay Not verified — do not invent a release date. What's New stays empty until a reviewer approves a verified release. This is not Room SMARTview and not Version SMARTview. Plans are never treated as shipped.

help-features-smartview-status.title: Production, Testing, Beta, In development
help-features-smartview-status.body: Features SMARTview shows Production (Prod) when Enable Feature is on and Enable Beta Feature is off. Testing is both flags on. Beta is Enable Beta Feature only. In development is Enable Feature off. Coming Soon is In development only. Dates stay Not verified — do not invent a release date. Merged on is a pull-request merge time, not Available since. Released is only shown with deployment or availability evidence. SAMPLE catalog rows and conversation claims are not proof of a live release.

help-features-smartview-botdee.title: Ask BOT DEE about a product
help-features-smartview-botdee.body: In BOT DEE say What can Mingl do, What can RydR do, What can floqCast do, What changed in ShoutOut, What is coming to Si-nema, or When was VIP reserV implemented. BOT DEE answers from the Features catalog with citations. It reports Production, Testing, Beta, or In development and will not treat a plan as shipped. Type Ver for Version SMARTview. Type Open Room SMARTview for a shared room. Those are different cards.

help-venue-command-center.title: Venue Command Center
help-venue-command-center.body: Approve ShoutOuts, review venue performance, and reconcile account activity for this location.

help-smartvisuals-create.title: Create / Edit SMARTvisuals
help-smartvisuals-create.body: Create or edit a SMARTstencil or SMARTbackground draft. Name is required. SMARTstencils must be SVG. SMARTbackgrounds accept SVG, JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Files are sanitized on the server. Drafts stay off patrons until an audited publish. Scenic art is FLOQR illustration, not photography and not an official destination or Fashion Week mark.

help-botdee-room-smartview-schedule.title: Join Now or set a schedule
help-botdee-room-smartview-schedule.body: After Room SMARTview setup, choose Join Now or Set a schedule. Join Now opens the BOT DEE session now and does not put a card on Search. Set a schedule is when the BOT DEE room starts — not Shared Itinerary. Saving a future time turns on Search SMARTnotification for you and invited Mingl friends only. Guests RSVP until the room is live, then Join Now opens BOT DEE (not Mingl chat).
